name: mongodb
description: The MongoDB Node driver (v6) contract for what mongoose needs: MongoClient (connection strings, server selection with serverSelectionTimeoutMS, a pool per worker thread, SCRAM-SHA-256), OP_MSG commands with BSON written from xisto values and read back as JSON, Db.command, Collection find/insert/update/delete/count/aggregate, bson's ObjectId, MongoServerError/MongoServerSelectionError. No TLS or mongodb+srv:// yet.
